label: PAPER config selected by the user. Not a deposit and not a live authorization.
bankNote: Six percent of this paper bank is a 12 dollar ceiling, not an order target.
cashNote: Free cash is the full 200 dollar paper bank. Locked capital is 0 because that is the entered split. 200 plus 0 equals the bank.
profitNote: A fresh paper journal is logical profit 0 and is not a real-money claim.
slippageNote: 100 basis points is 1 percent adverse price on the buy and again on the sell. Simulated only. Not a promised execution. Separate from the fee cap.
feeNote: Buy fee plus sell fee must be at most 4 percent of the entry notional. This 0.04 is not a per-leg cap. Both quote legs are required. No venue flat fee or referral is assumed. The old max(0.0045 * dollars, 0.95) floor is superseded and does not gate this policy.
